title: Korean Tteokbokki-Style Rice Cake Sauce
description: A brick-red, mildly spicy coating for tender rice cakes gets its color from tomato and gochugaru.

steps.title: Start the sauce
steps.text: Warm {oil} in the 10-inch HexClad skillet over medium-low heat.

steps.title: Toast gently
steps.text: Stir {garlic}, {chile} into the oil for 30 seconds, just until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the base
steps.text: Whisk in {broth}, {paste}, {miso}, {honey} gradually. Simmer gently for 5–7 minutes until the flavors come together.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Pour the slurry into the simmering sauce while whisking. Bubble gently for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Finish the sauce
steps.text: Fold in {sesame} off heat. Measure into a heatproof jug; add hot water to reach 1 cup, or simmer excess away before serving.

notes: Yield: 1 cup. Low-sodium option for the full batch: reduce mild white miso to 2.8 g and keep the same final yield. Use unsalted broth throughout. Option A uses the listed seasonings. For a gentler Option B, use half the pepper or chile if present and thin each portion with warm water. Make ahead: chill in small jars for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze in quarter-cup portions up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: whisk over low heat to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat as above. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 45 kcal, 1.1 g protein, 6.8 g total carbohydrate, 1.8 g fat, 0.6 g fiber, 113 mg sodium. Low-sodium version per 1/4 cup: 41 kcal, 0.8 g protein, 6.3 g total carbohydrate, 1.7 g fat, 0.5 g fiber, 36 mg sodium.
